title: 338章 降将诱兵击辽阳，两军对峙异变生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王化贞看着李永芳的亲笔信，信里写道：

罪臣李永芳百拜谨呈，大明辽东巡抚王公麾下：

臣自抚顺失节，降于建州，未尝一日忘大明也。每念及故土沦丧、百姓遭屠，肝肠寸断，恨不能即死以谢天下。然忍辱偷生至今者，实怀报国之志，欲待时而动，以赎前愆也。

今幸天诱其衷，建州气数将尽。西线蒙古林丹汗统十万铁骑压境，奴酋努尔哈赤惊惶失措，尽调八旗精锐西向抵御。皇太极之正白、镶白两旗，亦已拔营西去，辽阳城中，唯余老弱旗丁、新附汉军及辽东汉民万余，皆心向大明，日夜盼王师如大旱之望云霓。

臣虽受奴酋羁縻，然麾下旧部，尚有可恃。臣已密约城中义士，俟大军一至，即斩关为应，缚送奴酋首级，以献麾下。届时臣当阵前反正，倒戈相向，以迎王师。辽阳唾手可得，辽东指日可复。

机不可失，时不再来。伏乞巡抚大人速发雄师，星夜驰援，直捣辽阳。臣当率众内应，共襄义举。若迟则生变，恐奴酋回师，前功尽弃。

臣永芳顿首再拜，泣血以闻。

王化贞捏着李永芳的亲笔信，指节因用力而泛白，反复看了两遍，眼底的兴奋几乎要溢出来。信中字字泣血的归降之意，加上蒙古压境、后金精锐西调的说辞，恰好戳中他心头最迫切的念想——若能一举收复辽阳，他这辽东巡抚的功绩，便能彻底压过坐镇山海关、一味主守的熊廷弼，朝堂之上、陛下跟前，他便是再造辽东的功臣。

他当即传唤孙得功，将信拍在案上，沉声问道：“得功，你看有几分把握光复辽阳？”

孙得功接过信匆匆扫过，“噗通”一声跪倒在地，重重叩首，声音铿锵：“末将先在此恭贺抚台将为陛下、为大明立不世之功！蒙古铁骑如约压境，前番后金攻西平堡功败垂成、仓惶撤退，分明是被蒙古大军逼得进退两难，与李永芳信中内容分毫不差！正所谓：天与弗取，反受其咎；时至不行，反受其殃。末将恳请抚台即刻出兵，复我大明故土！”言罢又是一记响头磕在青砖上。

王化贞闻言抚掌大笑，只觉天时地利人和尽在掌握，此刻不出兵，更待何时？他正要击鼓升堂调兵遣将，孙得功却再次跪倒，声音陡然哽咽，带着哭腔道：“恩公，我孙得功是个粗人，不懂朝堂权谋，只懂滴水之恩当涌泉相报。您不顾流言提拔我这份恩情，得功没齿难忘。如今大军出征在即，末将愿做前锋，一报抚台提携之恩，二雪沈阳陷落之耻，望恩公成全！”

说罢，孙得功伏在地上，肩头不住抽动，哭声真切，全然一副忠肝义胆的悍将模样。王化贞看着他，心头暖意翻涌，愈发觉得东厂那些探子污蔑这般忠勇之将通敌，简直是荒谬至极、妒贤嫉能！这般主动请战、以死报恩的将领不是忠臣，世上再无忠臣！若让他做前锋，此战得胜，自己更是识人善用，何等风光？

王化贞故意沉吟片刻，轻叹一声：“既如此，便依你吧。”

孙得功猛地抬头，再次拜倒，嚎哭着嘶吼：“谢恩公，得功必以死报！”

哭声在大堂里回荡，王化贞被感动得一塌糊涂，满心都是收复辽阳的不世功绩。可他终究没看见，伏在地上的孙得功，垂在身侧的手早已攥得青筋暴起，那满脸热泪之下，藏着的是对后金的效忠，是对这场大明大军葬身之局的冰冷算计——这眼泪，究竟是为谁而流，唯有天知地知，他自己知。

不过半日，广宁中军大帐内，各路将领齐聚，甲胄铿锵，肃穆林立。

王化贞端坐帅案之后，一身绯色官袍，意气风发，眉宇间满是运筹帷幄的笃定，再无半分往日的焦躁。他伸手拿起案上令箭，沉声发令，声音传遍大帐每一处。

“刘渠听令！命你为援辽总兵官，统率镇武、闾阳两路兵马，即刻出征，先解西平堡之围，而后挥师直扑辽阳，不得有误！”

“末将遵令！”刘渠跨步上前，双手接过令箭，沉声领命。

“孙得功听令！命你为前锋总兵，统率本部精锐，为大军前驱，逢山开路遇水搭桥，探查敌军动向，不得有误！”

“末将遵命！定不辱使命！”孙得功躬身接箭，神态恭敬，眼神深处却掠过一丝阴鸷。

“祖大寿听令！命你为后军总兵，统领后军紧随主力，随时接应前军，稳固大军后路！”

“末将领令！”祖大寿沉声应下，接过令箭退至一旁。

一道道令箭掷下，众将纷纷接令，转身出帐备战，帐内将士渐渐散去，唯独中军游击江朝栋立于阶下，眉头紧锁，面色凝重，迟迟未曾挪动脚步。

待帐中只剩二人，江朝栋不再迟疑，“噗通”一声跪倒在地，脊背挺直，目光恳切，沉声道：“抚台大人，末将有死谏之言，恳请大人听我一言！”

王化贞正沉浸在调兵遣将的快感之中，见他如此，眉头瞬间拧起，语气带着几分不耐：“江朝栋，有话直说，无需多礼。”

“大人，孙得功此人，万万不可委以前锋重任！”江朝栋抬起头，语气急切，字字恳切，“东厂与锦衣卫接连送来密报，绝非空穴来风。此人平日里对您百般恭顺，可末将暗中观察，他眼神常有游移，私下与军中不明之人往来频繁，心性极为难测！”

“如今六万大军出征，关乎辽东防线存亡，关乎数万将士生死，将前锋重任、大军前驱托付于他，若是……若是他中途有变，倒戈相向，我大明六万将士必将陷入死地，广宁防线也会瞬间崩塌，一发不可收拾啊！”

王化贞闻言，脸色瞬间阴沉下来，原本的笑意荡然无存，周身气压骤低。他猛地一拍帅案，厉声呵斥：“放肆！孙得功乃本抚一手提拔的心腹爱将，忠心耿耿，日月可鉴，岂会通敌叛国？你这番言论，分明是听信朝党流言，刻意离间我与麾下将领，动摇军心！”

“大人！用人不疑、疑人不用没错，可这不是寻常战事，是关乎辽东存亡的决战，六万将士的性命，不能赌啊！”江朝栋急得额头青筋暴起，连连叩首，“恳请大人收回成命，撤换孙得功，改任祖大寿或其他忠勇可靠的将领为前锋，求大人三思！”

“住口！”王化贞勃然大怒，抓起案上的茶盏，狠狠砸在地上，瓷片碎裂四溅，“江朝栋，你身为中军游击，不思整军备战，反倒在此妖言惑众，扰乱军心！若不是看在你平日勤勉谨慎，颇有功劳，本抚今日定斩不饶！即刻滚出大帐，安心备战，再敢多言，军法处置！”

江朝栋看着暴怒不已、油盐不进的王化贞，心中五味杂陈，满眼皆是无奈与痛心。他深知王化贞心意已决，再多劝谏也是徒劳，只能仰天长叹一声，重重叩首：“大人执意如此，末将……末将无话可说！”

第(1/3)页

Wang Huazhen looked at Li Yongfang's handwritten letter, which wrote:

Li Yongfang, the guilty minister, pays 100 thanks and sincerely submits this letter to the prince, the governor of Liaodong in the Ming Dynasty:

I lost my integrity in Fushun and surrendered to Jianzhou. I have not forgotten the Ming Dynasty for a day.Every time I think about the loss of my homeland and the massacre of the people, my heart breaks, and I wish I could die immediately to thank the world.However, those who have endured humiliation and survived till now really have the ambition to serve the country and want to wait for the time to act to atone for their past mistakes.

Fortunately, God has tempted him, and his energy to build the state will be exhausted.On the western front, Mongolian Lindan Khan commanded 100,000 cavalry to press the border. The slave chief Nurhachi was panicked and mobilized the elite of the Eight Banners to resist westward.Huang Taiji's two flags, the straight white and the bordered white, have also left camp and gone west. In Liaoyang City, there are only old and weak bannermen, newly attached Han troops and more than ten thousand Han people in eastern Liaoning. They all yearn for the Ming Dynasty and look forward to the king's division day and night, like looking at the clouds during a severe drought.

Although I am under the control of a slave chief, I still have old troops under my command that I can rely on.I have secretly made a secret appointment with the righteous men in the city. As soon as the army arrives, I will cut off the pass and send the heads of the slave chiefs to my subordinates.At that time, the ministers would stand in front of the formation and turn against each other to meet the king's division.Liaoyang is at your fingertips, and Liaodong is within reach.

Don't miss this opportunity, it will never come again.Governor Fuqi quickly sent out his army to support Liaoyang under the starry night.The ministers should lead the people to respond internally and support the righteous deeds together.If it is too late, changes will occur, and the slave chief may return to the army, and all previous efforts will be wasted.

Chen Yongfang bowed his head and bowed again, weeping blood to hear it.

Wang Huazhen held Li Yongfang's autographed letter, her knuckles turning white from the force, and read it twice, the excitement in her eyes almost overflowing.The tearful meaning of surrender in every word in the letter, coupled with the Mongolian pressure and the Jin Dynasty's elite Western tune rhetoric, hit the most urgent thought in his heart - if he could regain Liaoyang in one fell swoop, his achievements as the governor of Liaodong would be completely surpassed by Xiong Tingbi, who was sitting in Shanhaiguan and blindly guarding the city. Above the court and in front of His Majesty, he would be the hero of rebuilding Liaodong.

He immediately summoned Sun Degong, slapped the letter on the case, and asked in a deep voice: "Degong, how sure do you think you are of regaining Liaoyang?"

Sun Degong took the letter and hurriedly scanned it. He knelt down with a "pop" and kowtowed heavily with a sonorous voice: "General, I would like to congratulate Futai for his immortal contribution to your majesty and the Ming Dynasty! The Mongolian cavalry pressed down on the border as promised. The previous attack on Xiping Fort by Houjin failed, and they retreated in panic.Ming was forced into a dilemma by the Mongolian army, which is exactly the same as what Li Yongfang wrote in his letter!As the saying goes: If you don't take it, you will be blamed; if the time is not right, you will suffer the disaster.I beg Futai to send troops immediately to restore our homeland of Ming Dynasty!" After saying this, he kowtowed on the green brick again.

When Wang Huazhen heard this, he put his palms in his hands and laughed. He felt that he had the right time, place, and people under his control. If he didn't send troops now, when would he wait?He was about to beat the drums to go up to the hall to mobilize his troops, but Sun Degong knelt down again, his voice suddenly choked with sobs, and he said with a cry: "My benefactor, my Sun Degong is a rough man. He doesn't understand the politics of the court. He only knows how a drop of kindness should be like a spring.I will repay you for your kindness in promoting me despite the rumors.Now that the army is about to go out, I will be the vanguard to repay the favor of Futai and save the shame of the fall of Shenyang.I hope my benefactor will be fulfilled!"

After saying that, Sun Degong lay on the ground, his shoulders twitching uncontrollably, his cry real, looking like a loyal and courageous warrior.Wang Huazhen looked at him, feeling warm in her heart. She felt more and more that those spies in Dongchang were slandering such a loyal and brave general as a collaborator. It was simply ridiculous and jealous of his talents!A general who takes the initiative to fight and repays his kindness with death is not a loyal minister. There are no more loyal ministers in the world!If he is allowed to be the vanguard and the battle is won, and he knows people well and uses them well, how glorious will it be?

Wang Huazhen deliberately pondered for a moment and sighed softly: "In that case, I'll let you do it."

Sun Degong suddenly raised his head and prostrated again, wailing and shouting: "Thank you, my lord, you will be rewarded with death!"

The cries echoed in the lobby. Wang Huazhen was moved to a complete mess, and his heart was filled with the unparalleled achievements of recapturing Liaoyang.But after all, he didn't see Sun Degong lying on the ground. The hands hanging by his sides had already been clenched with veins. Under the hot tears on his face, hidden was his loyalty to Hou Jin and his cold calculation for the fate of the Ming Dynasty's army. For whom these tears were shed, only God and the earth knew, and he himself knew.

Within half a day, generals from all walks of life gathered in the main tent of the Guangning Chinese Army, their armors clanging, and they stood solemnly.

After Wang Huazhen sat in command, she was dressed in a crimson official robe, high-spirited, and her brows were full of strategizing determination, and she no longer had the slightest anxiety of the past.He reached out and picked up the order arrow on the case, and issued the order in a deep voice, which spread throughout the tent.

"Liu Qu listens to the order! I order you to be the commander-in-chief of aiding the Liao Dynasty. You will command the troops from Zhenwu and Luyang. You will go out immediately to relieve the siege of Xiping Fort, and then send your troops to attack Liaoyang. There must be no mistakes!"

"General, obey the order!" Liu Qu stepped forward, took the order arrow with both hands, and accepted the order in a deep voice.

"Sun Degong listens to the order! I order you to be the forward commander, to lead the elite of the headquarters, to be the vanguard of the army, to build roads across mountains and rivers, to build bridges, to detect the enemy's movements, without making any mistakes!"

"General, I will obey your order! I will definitely fulfill my mission!" Sun Degong bowed to receive the arrow, with a respectful expression, but there was a hint of sinisterness in his eyes.

"Zu Dashou listens to the order! I order you to be the commander-in-chief of the rear army, command the rear army to follow the main force, coordinate with the front army at any time, and stabilize the army's rear path!"

"The last general's order!" Zu Dashou responded in a deep voice, took the order arrow and stepped aside.

Order arrows were thrown down one after another, and all the generals took orders one after another, turned around and went out of the tent to prepare for battle. The soldiers in the tent gradually dispersed, except for the Chinese guerrilla Jiang Chaodong who stood at the foot of the steps, his brows furrowed, his face solemn, and he had not moved for a long time.

There were only two people left in the waiting room. Jiang Chaodong no longer hesitated. He knelt down on the ground with a pop, his back straight, his eyes sincere, and he said in a deep voice: "Master Futai, there will be some words of advice in the end, please listen to me!"

Wang Huazhen was immersed in the pleasure of mobilizing troops and generals. Seeing him like this, her brows instantly furrowed, and her tone was a bit impatient: "Jiang Chaodong, just say what you have to say, no need to be polite."

"Sir, this person Sun Degong must not be entrusted with the important task of being a vanguard!" Jiang Chaodong raised his head, his tone was urgent and sincere, "Dongchang and Jinyiwei have sent secret reports one after another, and they are definitely not groundless. This person is usually very respectful to you, but the general is secretly observing him. His eyes are often wandering, he has frequent private contacts with unknown people in the army, and his character is extremely unpredictable!"

"Now that the 60,000-strong army is going out to fight, it is related to the survival of the Liaodong defense line, and the life and death of tens of thousands of soldiers. I entrust him with the important task of being the vanguard and the vanguard of the army. If...if he changes his mind midway and turns against him, our Ming Dynasty's 60,000 soldiers will surely fall into death, and the Guangning defense line will collapse in an instant, and it will be out of control!"

When Wang Huazhen heard this, her face instantly darkened, her original smile disappeared, and the air pressure around her body suddenly dropped.He slapped the handsome case and scolded sternly: "How presumptuous! Sun Degong is a confidant and favorite general promoted by Ben Fu. He is loyal and loyal, and the sun and the moon can teach him how to collude with the enemy and treason? Your remarks are clearly based on the rumors of the party, deliberately alienating me and the generals under my command, and shaking the morale of the army!"

"Sir! It is right to trust those who employ and those who doubt, but this is not an ordinary war. It is a decisive battle concerning the survival of Liaodong. The lives of 60,000 soldiers cannot be gambled!" Jiang Chaodong was so anxious that veins popped out on his forehead and he kowtowed repeatedly, "I beg you to take back your order, replace Sun Degong, and appoint Zu Dashou or other loyal and reliable generals as the vanguard. Please think again!"

"Shut up!" Wang Huazhen was furious. He grabbed the tea cup on the table and smashed it on the ground. The porcelain pieces shattered and scattered everywhere. "Jiang Chaodong, as a guerrilla in the Chinese army, you don't want to prepare for war. Instead, you are here to confuse the people and disturb the morale of the army! If it weren't for your usual diligence and caution, I will kill you today! Get out of the tent immediately and prepare for war. If you dare to say more, you will be punished by military law!"

Jiang Chaodong looked at Wang Huazhen, who was furious and unable to eat anything, with mixed feelings in his heart, and his eyes were full of helplessness and pain.He knew very well that Wang Huazhen had made up his mind, and that no matter how much he tried to persuade him, it would be in vain. He could only look up to the sky and sigh, and kowtowed heavily: "Your Excellency insists on this, the general...the general has nothing to say!"

Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 338: The general surrendered to lure troops to attack Liaoyang, and the two armies confronted each other.
